notes.title: 🎁 Free Weekend + Free new DLC: House Flipper Birthday Event is HERE!
notes.content:
It is the 7th time we're celebrating the birthday of the House Flipper franchise!

As every year, we have something special for you, and this time, it is a particularly exciting time, as the following events are taking place:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42979328/30e58fd01ffcc083fc0d34ea91aa04fab5d4d330.png[/img]


[h3]😱 House Flipper 2 Free Weekend![/h3]

That's right, tell everybody, invite your friends, and play together! This weekend, everybody can try House Flipper 2 for free and enjoy all the new content that arrives with the Free Co-op DLC release.
It's a great chance to see if you like the game and get it on an all-time high discount!

[b]The event lasts from 15 to 19 May[/b], enjoy!

[previewyoutube=KTQ2rVphj-k;full][/previewyoutube]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1190970/House_Flipper_2/

[h3]🤝 Free CO-OP DLC is OUT![/h3]

Designing, implementing, and polishing the CO-OP Mode in House Flipper 2 proved to be quite a tough journey! The release of the House Flipper 2 Co-op DLC is the final step!
It is officially the first DLC added to House Flipper 2, and it provides the Co-op mode fans with some extra content designed specifically for multiplayer fun. If you prefer to flip alone, all the new content can also be completed solo!
All that comes with an update to House Flipper 2, patch notes below!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3363370/House_Flipper_2__Coop_DLC/


[h3]📋 Official Co-op Release Update 1.8.[/h3]

[b]New:[/b]
• 4 new co-op jobs (can be played in single player – we won’t be checking): The first one is "Help us create a fun place!", unlocked after "A floor plan to change".
• 4 new co-op houses (also playable in single player). The first one is "Old marketplace".
• 92 new items! Details below.

[b]92 new items:[/b]
• 2 new wallpapers
• 7 new kinds of wall and ceiling molding
• Triangle windows with a 5-block base
• 3 elephant figurines
• 5 kinds of plushies
• Some small baby items
• Darts and a dartboard
• Film projector and film cans
• 6 kitchen containers
• 11 museum items including display cases and signs :)
• Picture lights - different sizes in one item!
• A chess set with individual pieces that slot nicely onto the board ;>
• Japanese maples
• Sago palms
• 4 path lights

[b]Changes:[/b]
• Custom pictures retain their aspect ratio when placed in frames.
• Customizing an item that changes its model removes attached items (e.g. changing the right door to left will remove any sticky note that stuck to it). Be aware!
• [Assembly] Removed the ability to move the camera with Ctrl+Mouse.
• [Assembly] Improved scene lighting.
• [Assembly][UI] Assembly star animation is faster.

[b]Fixes:[/b]
• Restored the menu exit button from the "Floor is Lava" map.
• [Sandbox] Fishing rod tool should now correctly drop rocks.
• [Sandbox] The "Ignore collisions" option in the "Transform tool" in mode "Resize" should now work correctly in all scenarios.
• [UI] The header in the popup when deleting a gallery photo is now translated correctly.

[b]Co-op new: [/b]
• Added pinging and emoticons (X on keyboard, D-pad up on controller)! Now you can really say what you think about that wall color 💩
• Added visual effects when cleaning stains and using detergent, so other players can see how much you're (not) helping.
• Added option to kick players from the lobby view.
• Added wall-building visual effect to be seen by other players.
• Added notification and countdown before reloading the game when a new player joins.
• Added item carrying animation.
• Improved player crouch animations - no more pretending to hold a shotgun!
• Added notification for internet connection problems.
• Added player nickname to the disconnect message.

[b]Co-op changes:[/b]
• Task progress under [TAB] syncs in near real-time.
• Synchronized material amounts in finishing boxes (tiles, panels, wallpaper) and paint buckets.
• Synchronized doors, laptop, TV channels, and light switches.
• Synchronized time of day when using the bed.
• Synchronized inventory key color.
• The online lobby join code is now hidden by default.
• The Join button is disabled when playing solo and not in the menu.

[b]Co-op fixes:[/b]
• Fixed disconnect issues when loading many houses in a row or one very large house.
• Multiple players unpacking a box at the same time will no longer break the game.
• Starting tools now sync correctly when transitioning between plots.
• Tools are now properly locked when joining Floor is Lava mode.
• Paint color on roller no longer resets when a new player joins.
• Items bought by the host will no longer be duplicated for clients.
• Client disconnects no longer leave behind a ghost of the item they were buying.
• When exiting a sandbox plot test to the main menu, all players are returned to the lobby (not just the host).
• After completing a job and skipping the before-after & messages, players are no longer pulled back into the job for a second.
• Flashlight beam direction matches the viewing direction.
• Disabled player shadows to avoid scaring others in co-op. It's not Halloween. Not yet.
• Fixed an issue where the session-end notification couldn’t be closed.


[h3]🏆 Time for a new Community Contest![/h3]

We're continuing to bring you new challenges and new prizes! The new Community Contest comes with another unique twist designed to put your Sandbox Mode skills to the test!
If you'd like to hop in and check out all the important information, click on the image below, or [url=https://mod.io/g/hf2/m/communitycontest#description][b]HERE[/b][/url]!

notes.title: 🤡 It's April Fools' Day! (Mini-Update!)
notes.content:
[hr][/hr][h3]🥳 April fool! [/h3]

Howdy Flippers!

Today, we bring you a little something to make your April Fools' Day more fun!
This is our first official "Mini-Update" - that's our new term to describe some of the smaller content additions to House Flipper 2.

[previewyoutube=hKiMi6kEubs;full][/previewyoutube]

[hr][/hr][h3]📋 Let's take a quick look at the changelog:[/h3]

[b]New:[/b]
• 6 April fools-related items so you can prank someone!
• A new mug with custom picture functionality!

[b]Changes:[/b]
• We lost a batch of our sound files, but we MacGyvered smth up overnight, and we're working on a more permanent solution. Be patient. (47 new sounds, but you can actually switch back to the original ones in the main menu! Only available on April 1st)

[b]Fixes:[/b]
• Pinnacove suburbs achievement is now correctly recognized.
• Fixed unremovable sills in the recently added house, "The Alligator Bar" in Old Pinnacove. The fix applies only to newly bought houses.

[b]Co-op changes:[/b]
• You can now disconnect from a co-op game using the Back button during loading (after confirming in a pop-up). Yes, now this is a feature, not a bug!
• Additional gameplay elements now synchronize properly: wall finish material held in hand, as well as paint roller mode and color.
• Third-person animations have been added for switching the cleaning tools and spray usage.
• Added additional notifications for "Lobby Full" and "Local Connection Not Possible".
• Crossplay status can now be toggled from the client join view.

[b]Co-op fixes:[/b]
• Fixed time of day synchronization.
• If the host is in the main menu, clients will also be placed in the main menu upon joining.
• If a player joins while others are still connecting or cleaning windows, they will no longer find them in an awkward position or animation.
• Cleaning the same stain is no longer slower when multiple players clean it together. Teamwork makes the dream work, not the job harder!

[b]❗ Additionally, we saved you from potential malicious features:[/b]
• Removed your favourite "before and after" gallery because at least 3 players didn't like it.
• Removed the co-op mode so you can finally enjoy playing alone in peace.
• All your mod.io houses got deleted because we forgot to pay our monthly mod.io premium subscription... what an awesome chance to upload new player creations!
• All textures are now one color (gray) to boost performance.
• Removed paint roller – now you must dip your hands in paint and slap the walls manually.
• Fixed a bug where only cold water was flowing from the taps.
• Removed all houses larger than 25m² or containing more than 20 items or 5 light sources – these could lead to uncontrollable crashes.
• Added an "ive-got-a-crash-on-you" command so you can now controllably crash your game as much as you like! (use at your own risk)



This marks our second step of the Q1 / Q2 2025 House Flipper 2 Roadmap.
What comes next is one of the biggest events of the year for the House Flipper Franchise, so make sure to stay tuned!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42979328/2cf78324ae532cd4b13688434be38a8275b00106.png[/img]

Additionally, keep in mind that you still have about 2 weeks to join our most recent Community Contest, which is actually all about some crazy April Fools' ideas!

Check it out by clicking [url=https://mod.io/g/hf2/m/communitycontest]HERE[/url] or on the image below:

[url=https://mod.io/g/hf2/m/communitycontest][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42979328/631c16b21a11ca0b4ae7cd0993f4e3ba7da6197f.png[/img][/url]

Hope to see you in-game today! Enjoy this Mini-Update, and have a wonderful day!

[*] Doorbells - ring ring!
[*] 4 new garden fences

notes.title: ☃️ Major Update Preview - Cozy Christmas! 🎄
notes.content:
[b]Ho ho ho![/b] 🎅

The winter season is getting wild so here we come with the final Major Update of 2024 that will allow you to start your Christmas preparations in House Flipper 2! With this update, we have quite a lot of stuff for ya, both content and news-wise.
Let's unwrap the presents and take a peek at what's inside:


[h3]🎁 The "Cozy Christmas" Update comes on December 12![/h3][hr][/hr]
We're delivering a sweet chunk of content to make your snowy house designs possible! In this announcement, you can expect a bit of a sneak peek, and on December 12, you'll be able to download the update for free and check out all of its content!  Along with the release you might want to go through the patch-notes list and hang out with us on the Xmas dev stream! A new Community Contest is also on the way!


[b]So the first thing to show you should be snow... LOTS OF SNOW![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42979328/71797557bf5f00d684b48acdad089345d8565893.jpg[/img][i]A quick snapshot of the new environment![/i]


[b]Then we of course have a snowy house unlocked upon completing a new heartwarming job![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42979328/4521b774b88b5d4dbc3ca3514399e9ca12887dfc.jpg[/img][i]Yup, that will need some more lights and garlands! MAKE IT SHINE![/i]


[b]We're throwing in a bunch of new items (260 of them to be exact!) like Christmas decorations, cute nightlights, and much more![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42979328/2bc8a74482e4174390e2d964d5e541485b0da264.jpg[/img][i]Undeniably cute![/i]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42979328/2336faf168a84737cc91c53674eca259f210506f.jpg[/img][i]We've really put some effort into bringing you options to choose from![/i]


[b]And a little something for the assembly lovers![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42979328/5a070e44d91780971c99e423b2bc2b4f369a5b75.jpg[/img][i]Build it yourself![/i]

As always, we'll post a full list of additions and changes once the update comes out on December 12. In addition to new content, you can expect some minor fixes and quality-of-life improvements.



[h3]🔴 Remember about the upcoming Xmas Dev Livestream! [/h3][hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42979328/410c3f21ca68b23d5011831109172198793226c7.png[/img]
A bunch of spicy topics on this one, right?

[b]December 12, 6:00 PM CET! Be there or be square![/b]

Twitch: https://www.twitch.tv/frozen_district

Youtube: https://www.youtube.com/@HouseFlipperGame




[h3]🌲 In the meantime, you gotta check something out![/h3][hr][/hr]
There's a fun new project we are currently working on. [b]A cozy game called Your Tree![/b]

[previewyoutube=bFqm6J81crE;full][/previewyoutube]

It is a cozy, relaxing game about growing trees. You choose every detail, such as trunks and leaves, change the tree's colors, and decide on ornaments around... your tree! A perfect experience to let off some steam.

If you enjoy the idea and would like to show it some love, add Your Tree to your Steam Wishlist:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3133020/Your_Tree/

[hr][/hr][i]That's it for today guys! Thanks for tuning in, and we hope you like what you see! Make sure to check [url=https://houseflipper2.canny.io/]our feature board on Canny.io[/url] and vote for your favorite ideas! Keep in mind that this board is one of our main tools regarding planning the content for the game - your votes matter! After all, your voice is one of the key ingredients for updates like this one! 

Stay safe and have an awesome day! ❤️

notes.title: 🎃 "Bewitching Renovations" - Major Update #5 OUT NOW 🦇
notes.content:
[h3]🕯️ The fifth major update for House Flipper 2 is live![/h3][hr][/hr]
Download it (should happen automatically), get ready for a spooktacular gaming session, and check out what's been added to the game!

[previewyoutube=PMgZV70k4PY;full][/previewyoutube]

Halloween updates have a special place in our hearts, we always had lots of fun doing those each year, and this one is no exception! 👻

We are so grateful for all of your support. With every major update, the content for House Flipper 2 becomes so much more diverse, and it's all thanks to your suggestions and feedback!
We're currently deep into  [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1190970/view/4353375593646748361]our latest roadmap[/url][/b], and that means that you can expect some fresh info for the development journey of House Flipper 2 to arrive in the upcoming months! Meanwhile, make sure to check [b][url=https://houseflipper2.canny.io/]our feature board on Canny.io[/url][/b] and vote for your favorite ideas! Keep in mind that this board is one of our main tools regarding planning the content for the game - your votes matter!



[h3]📜 Changelog time![/h3][hr][/hr]
[h3]New:[/h3][list]
[*] New job: "My house might scare away all the little ghosts" in Old Pinnacove. (Unlocks after Cleaning up after the flood or More light, please)
[*] Brand new property: "Vacant Private School" in Old Pinnacove. Don’t let the creaky floors scare you off.
[*] Over 230 new items! (Details below. Don’t worry, no trick items here. Or are there?)
[*] Character customization expanded! New character models and pronoun options.
[*] New assembly: Candelabra – light up your nights with some spooky elegance.
[*] Perk "Can of All Colors" under the Paint category. You can choose any color you want!
[*] New Buyers tab (unlocked after buying your first house).
[*] New vacuumable objects added to sandbox mode.[/list]
[b]Over 230 new items:[/b][list]
[*] 13 new windows, including a brand new gothic style
[*] Gothic architectural elements - ceiling panels, wall panels, mouldings and corbels!
[*] 4 new gothic fences
[*] 4 door frames and 2 doors
[*] Misc decorations such as...a barrel, fireplace logs, fireplaces, globes, a clock, a display case and a storage chest
[*] Custom color paint! Unlock the perk and paint with any color of the rainbow
[*] 3 kinds of stone, 1 kind of wood and 3 new patterns - also available as surface finishes and wallpaper
[*] Several witchy items for all your magical needs - potions, cauldrons and spoooky candy containers
[*] Carved pumpkins and a witch hat you can put on them
[*] A witch's broom and matching broom stand
[*] Halloween paper garlands
[*] A gothic living room set
[*] A gothic library office set
[*] A gothic candelabra set
[*] A lovely cozy patio set
[*] Hanging herbs
[*] 10 bathroom accessories for all beard-bearing people
[*] 6 door mats and 1 bath mat
[*] Paper money stacks, cash register, a store counter and refrigerated store displays
[*] Pizza board and pizza peel
[*] A mannequin and clothes rack
[*] A larger coffee machine and portafilter
[*] A custom text sticky note - write your own!
[*] Greeting cards[/list]
[b]A plethora of plants such as:[/b][list]
[*] Lenten roses
[*] Nandina plants in purple and red
[*] Cherry plum trees
[*] Corkscrew filbert trees
[*] Pine trees
[*] Willow trees[/list]

[h3]Changes:[/h3][list]
[*] Creating unpacking quests in Sandbox Mode is now easier. Buy the unpacking box and use the Hands tool to put items in and take them out!  
[*] Building walls in concrete pouring mode now turns the finished product to concrete instead of bricks!
[*] Tiling walls with the same tiles will now highlight the overlap. 
[*] You can now see the whole list of locked assemblies.
[*] The assembly panel is updated with arrow-key camera rotation and better gamepad support.
[*] The star timer for assemblies has been extended.
[*] You can now sit on even more benches and chairs.
[*] Instruments now make a sound when you press 'E'.
[*] You can now throw trash bags into the big commercial trash bin.
[*] Trespassing trees have been removed from Pinnacove Suburbs. Be free from your neighbours tree choices.
[*] Herbs now have an alternative dried version, just in case you're crafting potions.
[*] Cobweb rework – easier to spot, and they no longer mysteriously fall on their own.
[*] Added a sound for quest completions in rooms. You'll hear about your success!
[*] Resizable items now have a filter in the store.
[*] Added a saturation slider in settings – turn down the creepiness or crank it up!
[*] Settings now come with descriptions.
[*] Added tooltips for color names.
[*] New loading screen tips!
[*] mod.io: Added a progress bar for mod downloads & installs.
[*] mod.io: Filters added for browsing houses.[/list]

[h3]Fixes:[/h3][list]
[*] Garage door stains now move along with the doors.
[*] Placing fences has been improved.
[*] Fixed the reset of the refresh rate at the game start.
[*] Fixed some collision issues between trash bags and players.
[*] Selling items by holding now correctly highlights sellable items.[/list]

[h3]Co-op:[/h3][list]
[*] Tools unlocked in multiplayer campaigns are now available in single-player campaigns too.
[*] Hosts can now kick clients.
[*] An automatic answering machine is available for all players.
[*] Players no longer collide with each other.
[*] The first version of "Floor is Lava" – players can see each other, but only your time matters at the finish line.
[*] Fixed model resetting in third-person view.[/list]


[h3]🧟 New Community Contest with a special sponsor: LogitechG! 💙[/h3][hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42979328/8525f0f0f089b5d45ff5380d773c2cb577a02675.png[/img]

This time it's [b]not just about the house[/b], it's also a bit about the [b]story side of the project[/b]! Come up with a [b]monster-themed property[/b] (it can be based on ANY monster - one you know or just made up!) and on top of that make sure that the house shares some [b]spicy details about the monstrous host's Halloween plans[/b]! Are the witches meeting up for a party? Or is it a bunch of banshees planning a ball? Did someone mention a corpse cookout?! 

[b]Unleash your building ([i]and storytelling![/i]) creativity! 👻[/b]
[b][url=https://mod.io/g/hf2/m/communitycontest]https://mod.io/g/hf2/m/communitycontest[/url][/b]


[b]Prizes, sponsored by Logitech G:[/b]
When it comes to the prizes, twelve participants, in total, will win exclusive goodies!

[b]7th to 10th:[/b] G309 LIGHTSPEED Gaming Mouse
[b]BONUS Giveaway for all the participants:[/b] We have two additional G309 LIGHTSPEED Gaming Mice that will make their way to two lucky contest participants!

[i]Kudos to the guys at Logitech G, it's awesome to reward our community with some suuuuper fancy gear![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42979328/6a71c883ab0ca64f0a77bd4d14dec47c44c245de.png[/img]

Twitch: https://www.twitch.tv/frozen_district

Come hang out with us! As always, we wanna answer some questions, get some good vibes going, and spend some time with the community! Not only we're talking about the [b]HF2 content that just came out[/b], but we also want to show you some new exclusive gameplay from the [b]upcoming Dine Out DLC[/b]!

notes.title: 😎 "Summer in Old Pinnacove" - Major Update #4! 🍹
notes.content:
[hr][/hr][i]2 days ago we greeted you with an [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1190970/view/4360131627026270723]update preview[/url][/b], and today we're ready to roll![/i] 🥵

[i]This update is the 4th House Flipper 2 major content update, and it is the first step on our recently released [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1190970/announcements/detail/4353375593646748362]House Flipper 2 Roadmap - Part 2[/url][/b], and you should definitely check it out because there's so much more to come! Let's get to all the news, because we've got plenty of that for you today![/i]


[previewyoutube=lJ3tff_8H7k;full][/previewyoutube][b]While you're downloading the update, check out the list of patch notes:[/b]


[h3]New:[/h3][list]
[*] Get ready to explore Old Pinnacove, a brand-new region with a fresh downtown vibe!
[*] Dive into a new job in the new region, where you'll help Simon, an allergy sufferer, with his apartment makeover.
[*] Check out a charming new apartment in the heart of a historic tenement building.
[*] 150 new items! (Hold onto your toolboxes! Details below).
[*] 13 new images for Custom Pictures.
[*] Get an SMS from your client after finishing a job. Because who doesn't love a good debrief?
[*] Enjoy the new visual and sound effects when bags bounce off the invisible boundary wall. It's like magic but with bags!
[*] Now you can tweak Chromatic Aberration in the settings.
[*] Introducing the "Unstuck" button in the pause menu (under escape). Perfect for those moments when you find yourself wedged between items or walls.
[*] Say hello to a new company for items, FixeD! Looks familiar?
﻿

[b]150 new items:[/b]
- 12 fun beach toys for your inner child.
- Flip-flops, sunglasses, and other summer essentials.
- Invasive weed species to spice up your garden battles.
- A cozy campfire for those summer nights.
- Downtown-themed goodies: benches, fire hydrants, traffic lights.
- Stylish awnings to keep things cool.
- Bigger balcony doors.
- Decorative moss and vintage suede - now available in Story mode.
- A bunch of colorful rhododendrons.
- Adorable bee-themed kitchen accessories (Pipit).
- Cozy Rosie patio furniture (Sandpiper). Perfect for lounging!
- 20 doors of different widths. Open up to new possibilities!
- 6 new towels. Drying off has never been this stylish!
- Store rack shelf and commercial fridge for your budding business empire.
- Classic instruments to bring out your inner musician.
- A new bedroom set for Valenti (Windsor), featuring a secret door. Shh, don't tell anyone![/list]
[h3]Changes:[/h3][list]
[*] Curtains can now be stretched downwards.
[*] Open and close curtains with just a press of a button!
[*] Feel free to place items on the gazebo and scaffolding.
[*] Buying multiple lights? They keep their settings now.
[*] Copy surface styles on architectural elements, just like you copy wall styles.
[*] A friendly reminder before deleting old progress when starting a new game.
[*] Jobs in the archive now have a "continue" button, so you can pick up right where you left off.
[*] Refrigerators, microwaves, and ovens now come with internal lighting.
[*] Larger items now require a longer click to sell. No more accidental sales!
[*] Store categories are now sorted with intention, not semi-alphabetically.[/list]
[h3]Fixes:[/h3][list]
[*] Fixed the text input in the store search field, especially improving functionality in certain modes or on specific devices.
[*] The ceiling fan in Jonesboro has been corrected to be properly resizable.[/list]



[h3]🌸 Fairytale Community Contest Winners reveal![/h3][hr][/hr]
[previewyoutube=-uzJ8ntXBT0;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]Congrats to all the winners![/b] It was a stunning show of creativity and Sandbox Mode mastery! 🙀

We couldn't pass on highlighting a couple of projects as "honorable mentions" because they were just so incredibly close to making it to top 6!
We will be contacting you guys on Mod.io in order to discuss how you get your prizes! Love ya! 💖




[h3]🏖️ A brand new Community Contest STARTS NOW![/h3][hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42979328/73d5e53347a4374af81cc179cb2cb741f97a9c38.png[/img]
Another chance to prove how good you are in the Sandbox Mode bussiness! This time we'd like to invite you to showcase your best builds in a new theme! 🌅

[b]Show us your best idea for a "Summer Getaway" house![/b]  It's a pretty open theme, with a lot of room for interpretation, so don't hesitate to experiment! The rules are once again, very simple, and you can read about all of the details on the [b][url=https://mod.io/g/hf2/m/communitycontest]official Mod.io page of the contest[/url][/b]!




[h3]🔴 Don't forget that today we're streaming to celebrate the new update![/h3][hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42979328/b61cd6bb391d9fa14df122c86261cde52197aa4a.png[/img]
I know that a lot of you guys might have lots of questions!
We will try to answer as many as possible, and spend some good time with the community of Flippers!

[b]August 1, 6:00 PM CEST! Be there or be square![/b]
Twitch: https://www.twitch.tv/frozen_district

Youtube: https://www.youtube.com/@HouseFlipperGame




[h3]🎨 Let's experience more of the creativity from our Flipping community![/h3][hr][/hr]
[previewyoutube=V2MOf8Qc_6c;full][/previewyoutube]

And that seems to be all for now! [b]BIG THANKS[/b] to everyone who's supporting us, sharing inspirational ideas, and providing constructive criticism about House Flipper 2's development journey!

Have lots of fun with the new update, and a wonderful rest of the week! 💙💙💙

[h3]🏆 The second House Flipper 2 Community Contest starts NOW![/h3]
[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42979328/92b5d59d1ff81cb47e0fd2f71cc06e88f3446ef3.png[/img]

Oh yeah!
With this update, it's much more than just new content prepared by us, the devs.
You can create your very own lava tracks and levels, share them with us, and even compete in the Community Contest for the best lava track in the Flipper community!


[h3]📝 The rules are simple![/h3]

1. Create a new property in the House Flipper 2 Sandbox Mode.

2. Build a track / course fitting the theme of the Contest - “Floor is Lava”:

b) [b]Remember that your project also has to contain the following items:[/b][list]
[*] A Start gate
[*] At least one Checkpoint gate
[*] A Finish gate[/list]These can be found in the House Flipper 2 in-game item store, in the Sandbox Only/Minigames category

3. Upload the finished property to the [b][url=https://mod.io/g/hf2]Mod.io website[/url][/b] with [b]at least 3 screenshots[/b] best showcasing the project, as well as check the [b]“Floor is Lava” tag[/b] in the upload process.

[b]Visual Masterpiece[/b] - in this category, we will be rating the entries by how visually creative and appealing the entries are, within the theme of “Floor is Lava” of course! Go totally ham with unique designs and show us how awesome your lava track can look like!



When it comes to the rewards, three participants in each category, so six participants in total, will win exclusive House Flipper goodies!

[b]1st place in each category:[/b] The House Flipper 2 Microsoft Controller!
[b]2nd places:[/b] The steelbox version of House Flipper 2!
[b]3rd places:[/b] Bessie the Beaver plushie!

I hope you'll love this update as much as we do here in Frozen District.

[previewyoutube=BDPNLQ94Q5w;full][/previewyoutube]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1190970/House_Flipper_2/

[hr][/hr]
[h3]New:[/h3][list]
[*] "Healthier lifestyle for a change" - a brand new job!
[*] "House left behind" - a new house you can buy after completing the job!
[*] 240 new items (details below) 📋
[*] Resizing - now available in Story Mode for certain items! Look for it in the Flipper Tool's “Change style” panel. Resizable items can be recognized in the store by looking at the icon with two arrows, shown in the top left corner of the item preview in the store.
[*] Resizeable items from the “Sandbox only” category were moved to “Architectural elements/Other” and are also available in Story Mode. Say hello to columns and floor mouldings!
[*] Sell roofs and stairs in Story Mode (hold LMB)! Also works in the Sandbox “Play” and “Test property” modes.
[*] Certain items like fireplaces and candles can now light up! 🔥
[*] Textiles are now available as surface finish options in Sandbox Mode!
[*] A new perk - "Well deserved rest" - which will let you sleep in beds.
[*] 4 new special buyers (for a total of 11)
[*] Two new assemblies - a hanging and a standing kitchen cabinet.
[*] Toy trains placed on tracks are now interactive! Choo choo!
[*] A new sound for window cleaning.
[*] Flower petals - a new vacuumable dirt.
[*] [UI] Progress bar for jobs with a fancy animation when all 3 stars are obtained.
[*] [UI] You can now complete jobs with a button in the Quest tab.

[b]New items include:[/b]
- Step ladder 
- 10 cute plant pots 🦊
- 5 new types of plants 
- 12 new spring-themed patterns - can be used on items or as wallpapers!
- More green vines
- Backpacks, bags, shoes, gloves, and hats 🧢

- Accessories for taking care of hair
- Valenti dinner set
- Valenti bathroom accessories
- Valenti hallway set
- Extravaganza office set 👁️ 👄 👁️
- Skadi living room set
- The Cent shelving unit[/list]

[h3]Changes:[/h3][list]
[*] The game now stops responding to inputs when you minimize it.
[*] The store sorting option for dates are now less confusingly called “Date: from newest” and “Date: from oldest”. Useful for seeing what’s new in the update 👀
[*] Clothes will now be easier to hang on hangers.
[*] The auction fee is now lower for cheaper houses and higher for more expensive ones.
[*] Fixes to the trampoline! (Say goodbye to unwanted space trips and hello to dynamic diagonal dives - I'm sure this won't come in handy 🌋)
[*] Textiles such as carpet tiles have been moved to the right category in the store (Surface finishes) and have been fully translated.
[*] Reworked some buttons in the “Change style” panel to make them easier to understand (e.g., for plants - "Soil" - "Yes/No").
[*] Items from the "Sandbox Only" category can no longer be used in a “To Buy” quest in jobs.
[*] Stains placed in Sandbox Mode will now disappear automatically if they're small enough.
[*] We've optimized stain highlights while using the "Dirt management" tool.
[*] The new perk - “Well deserved rest” lets you control the time of day in a house you own. You’ll do this by sleeping in a bed, changing the time to morning or night. Important! Changing the “Game time” option in the settings will only have a visual effect on clocks.
[*] Changing the time in the “Property settings” tab in Sandbox mode now also changes the time while making a level as well. No more going in and out of the “Test property” mode to see if the sun is high enough!
[*] The progression of the Mount Everest achievement now properly scales with the size of your paint roller
[*] [UI] Added an animation when hovering over the series or name of an item, and the company logo in the store. This shows you can click on them for easy searching.
[*] [UI] The auction fee is now shown on the button for putting a house up for auction
[*] When building walls in Sandbox Mode, the preview of the chosen material is now bigger.
[*] The "unstuck" and "reset-to-spawn-position" commands are now visible in the console (F11).[/list]

[*] Further advancements with our war on corrupted save files (we're winning, aren't we?)
[*] Improved recognition of presets when switching between them in the “Change style” panel
[*] Pool balls are now arranged in the correct order in the “Change style” panel
[*] Building walls on stains should now clean the stains
[*] The game now correctly calculates the amount of money paid for the auction immediately after putting a house up for auction
[*] Fixed the spray VFX
[*] The "Spray" tooltip shows up only when the "Cleaning spray" perk is active
[*] Removed the Confounded Face emoji from the bottom right corner of the screen 😖. Bye friend![/list]
[hr][/hr]⚠️⚠️⚠️

To be frank, we already had something ready, a bit more than a prototype of this feature, but we felt that instead of releasing it now, we wanna take our time and bring it to you once we're fully happy with the results! From the development perspective, this feature isn't as simple as it may seem, and considering how many players are interested in it, we aim to bring it to a higher standard![/i]

notes.title: House Flipper 2 Status Report 📋
notes.content:
[h3]👋 How's it going Flippers?[/h3][hr][/hr]
Today, [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1190970/announcements/detail/6106382177078964041?snr=2___]exactly a month after the official House Flipper 2 release[/url][/b], I greet you with a little wall of text, as I'm pretty sure a lot of you are waiting for information regarding the current status of House Flipper 2, and what exactly the team at Frozen District is focused on after the release. The winter holiday season is finished, we're all back in the office, and we know that the future weeks will be full of work and dedication.

Let's do a little dev diary to discuss the current situation, as well as where we're headed regarding our development efforts:



[h3]🚧 The current situation[/h3][hr][/hr]
House Flipper 2 is up and running, and we feel like the official release was a huge success - a success that wouldn't be possible without your help and support! Looking at the feedback from the community we can see that a lot of you love the game and are super satisfied with the purchase.
[b]BUT!...[/b]

That's sadly not true for all the House Flipper 2 players, and we know that there's still a lot of work ahead of us. Luckily, the Flipper community once again showed us its value, and we received a lot of constructive criticism regarding many different aspects of the game. The biggest quest for us at the moment is gathering, analyzing, and evaluating all this feedback. That's something we've been doing for the last couple of weeks, and we already have an idea of what the priority list looks like for us.

[b]Currently, we're definitely focusing our attention on bugs[/b], especially the ones that are blocking some players from playing House Flipper 2. What I mean by that is mainly all the saving-related issues that either wipe your progress or block the saving mechanism thus preventing you from progressing in the game.
We also have some other cheeky ones, like the infinite scrolling bug that you guys let us know about [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1190970/discussions/0/]through our Steam Discussions[/url][/b]. Thank you all for reporting those, and any other issues. Our testers and programmers are already on it!

A lot of you also pointed out that House Flipper 2 is missing some crucial content pieces, for example, [b]curtains and window blinds, or the beloved Before/After mechanic[/b]. We're fully aware of that, and thanks to our new [b][url=https://houseflipper2.canny.io/]House Flipper 2 Roadmap and Feature Board[/url][/b], we can see what your votes are and what features are the most important to you and your gameplay experience. Thank you for taking part in the voting!



[h3]🔮 The future[/h3][hr][/hr]
[b]Our first hotfix update is already planned to come next week if everything goes smoothly[/b]. This one will cover a portion of the most serious issues ([i]those that we could fix fairly quickly[/i]), but keep in mind that some of them require a little bit extra time on our side.
That's why we're also already working on another hotfix update that will come after that. We will make sure to keep you updated about the situation on our [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1190970/discussions/2/]Steam Discussions[/url][/b].

Moreover, while our programmers are tracing all the bugs and working on the fixes, a part of the development team is also busy with the upcoming [b]Spring Content Update[/b] ([i]which we'll be discussing sometime in the following weeks![/i]), and [b]our artists are already creating new item sets![/b]
Take a look at this little sneak peek:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42979328/543525f101a147994abba43e4337d19befec590a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42979328/dd64d21471b08d62f73ae5603b81dbfa9635a716.png[/img]
Those might be arriving with the [b]Spring Content Update[/b] or maybe a bit before, not sure yet, but I promise to keep you updated on that!

Last but not least, our community team will still be doing their best to listen to your reports and ideas in the following weeks.
[b]Your input is greatly appreciated and without your help, we wouldn't be where we currently are![/b]

[hr][/hr]Have a lovely rest of the weekend! ❤️❤️

notes.content:
[h3]🎙️ The last couple of days were full of your suggestions![/h3]

Since the release, you guys have been very active on various player-developer communication channels.
Thanks to that, we were able to discover some overlooks on our side and decided to act quickly before the winter holiday break!

For the last week, we tried gathering as much feedback as possible, especially keeping a close eye on our  [b][url=https://houseflipper2.canny.io/]new feature request board on Canny.io[/url][/b]!

[hr][/hr]If you don't know what [b][url=https://houseflipper2.canny.io/]Canny.io[/url][/b] is, it's a platform where our players can:[list]
[*] See what we have planned for the future of House Flipper 2
[*] Influence this plan by commenting on and upvoting the things that they think are a priority.
[*] Create posts that contain player ideas for new content. These posts can then be upvoted by the rest of the community members and implemented into the House Flipper 2 roadmap.[/list]

Click the banner below or one of the above links to join the fun!

[url=https://houseflipper2.canny.io/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42979328/35de3c1ae8b0e60c39d78465ddbdecb2634f383a.png[/img][/url]

[hr][/hr]
[h3]📜 The Feature Update patch notes:[/h3]

Today, we're delivering some simple, yet very effective quality-of-life features which were instantly requested by our community right after the release:[list]

[*] Added a [b]Hold / Toggle option[/b] inside the Settings > Gameplay Tab. This feature works with:[list]- painting
- general cleaning
- window cleaning
- wall building
- vacuuming[/list]([b]Important:[/b] the tooltips will still suggest that you're using the hold option, don't worry about it, we'll change that soon!)

[*] Added options for [b]inverted X/Y mouse movement settings[/b] in the Settings > Gameplay Tab.
[*] Added WASD tooltips when painting and cleaning windows.
[*] Added a popup suggesting lower graphics settings in case of a game crash.
[*] Optimized window cleaning to work better on low-end GPUs.
[*] The game now triggers an autosave upon entering the assembly mechanic.
[*] Fixed disappearing assembly elements!
[*] Fixed the issues encountered during the drilling phase in the assembly mechanic.
[*] Property photos are now getting automatically exported along with uploading the property to Mod.io
[*] The popup about not being able to sell your parents' house is now displayed properly.
[*] Added support for all keyboard layouts (yikes!).
[*] Added variety regarding TV shows on different properties.
[*] Reflections should no longer go crazy on your GPU memory.
[*] Optimization improvements for various stains.
[*] BIGGER FONTS for Steam Deck users![/list]


We also performed a couple of tests regarding [b]motion sickness[/b] in House Flipper 2
Generally, what seems to be working is:[list]
[*] Turning off FSR [i](but we still love AMD!)[/i]
[*] Turning off Motion Blur
[*] Disabling V-Sync and setting your fps to match your monitor refresh rate.[/list]


[hr][/hr]
[i]That's it, folks! We will be back with more updates in 2024!
Cheers, have a wonderful rest of the week! ❤️[/i]

notes.title: Meet the Sandbox Mode!
notes.content:
[h3]Howdy Flippers![/h3]

For the last couple of weeks, we have been thinking about how to better visualize the part of House Flipper 2 that some of you may not know. Till now, we only showcased it during occasional developer streams as well as on a couple of screenshots. Since it's going to be an extremely important part of HF2, we've decided to create a trailer that is going to showcase the vast majority of features available there.

[h3]We would like to fully introduce you to [b]House Flipper 2 Sandbox Mode[/b]![/h3]

We, the devs, created each and every house in our game using the tools found in the Sandbox Mode. 
Now, with the upcoming release of House Flipper 2, it's going to be your turn to sit behind the controls!
Create and share your own custom houses and quests, completely from the ground up!

After you're done, share them with the House Flipper community through MOD.io, and let your friends play through your creations, and complete the jobs you set up for them!
Sharing your creations has never been easier before!

[previewyoutube=tqEgsLm442c;full][/previewyoutube]

We're thrilled to be posting this, as deep in our hearts we have huge expectations when it comes to the Sandbox Mode.

Just as a reminder, House Flipper 2 is going to be divided into 2 modes:
- The Story Mode, which is the one you know from the first House Flipper already.
- The additional Sandbox Mode, which is basically a "House Flipper goes fully creative", as presented in the above trailer. From an empty plot to a 3-story mansion or whatever else you may like! 

Thank you so much for being here with us and patiently waiting for the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1190970/view/3676679309281816996][b]release in December.[/b][/url]
We can't wait either, but before that comes, we still have some extra stuff waiting for you, just to spice up the atmosphere and tease you with some juicy sneak peeks.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1190970/House_Flipper_2/


Have a fantastic day y'all!
